name: PT Hotel Sahid Jaya International Tbk
summary: PT Hotel Sahid Jaya International Tbk operates and manages hotels in Indonesia. It operates and manages various serviced apartment units, as well as involved in the retail trade of alcoholic beverages; and the operation of bars and restaurants. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Hotel Sahid Jaya International Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Empu Sahid International.
